onlyOfficeViewer.changedOnDisk: This file changed on disk while you were editing it, so your changes aren't saved yet.
onlyOfficeViewer.couldNotOpen: This document couldn't be opened in the editor.
onlyOfficeViewer.editorNeedsAddressBrowser: The editor needs an address the browser can reach. Your sandbox isn't reachable from outside yet: finish setup so it registers its address.
onlyOfficeViewer.onlyofficeDocsRunsContainer: ONLYOFFICE Docs runs as a container in this sandbox's Docker engine, which isn't on. {detail}
onlyOfficeViewer.openEditSaveDocument: Open, edit and save this document in ONLYOFFICE Docs. The first start downloads the document server, about 2 GB, once.
onlyOfficeViewer.openEditSaveInBrowser: Open, edit and save this document with ONLYOFFICE, right in your browser. The first open downloads the editor, about 200 MB, once.
onlyOfficeViewer.originalKeptAt: Kept {when}: the document as it was before this window first saved it.
onlyOfficeViewer.originalKeptHint: The document as it was before this window first saved it.
onlyOfficeViewer.restoreOriginalBody: The document goes back to how it was before this window first saved it. What was saved since, and any edits not saved yet, are replaced.
onlyOfficeViewer.savedAsCopy: Your version was saved as {path}. This editor now shows the file on disk.
onlyOfficeViewer.startSandboxNowOn: Get it ready with the sandbox from now on
onlyOfficeViewer.startingDocumentServerCold: Starting the document server… A cold start takes about two minutes: it regenerates its fonts and themes every time. It stays up afterwards.
onlyOfficeViewer.textUntilEditor: Showing the document's text until the editor is ready.
